description:
Top Fashion18 specialises in selling women's fashion and plus size clothing from sizes 6 through to 32.  Our products are designed and manufactured in the UK.  

We understand fashion and trends change regularly and are always adding stylish women's clothing to our product range at truly affordable prices.
We want to offer you a fabulous choice at amazing prices.

We love selling plus size clothing and our sizing specification means that you will get a great fitting item that you will love.

We are based in the North West, we work closely with the manufacturing factory as well as the distribution center.  We have been in business since 2012.  Starting out on the UK market stalls, to now selling online for the past 6 years. 

We are a family run business and pride ourselves on our customer service, we can also partner with you to sell our brand if you are a business seller.

For any information, please contact us
